# One-Day Meal Plan for Boxing Athlete
**Target: 2000 calories | High protein, moderate carbs for competition prep**

---

## BREAKFAST (450 cal)
**Oatmeal Power Bowl**
- 1 cup cooked oatmeal (150 cal)
- 2 whole eggs + 2 egg whites scrambled (150 cal)
- 1 banana (105 cal)
- 1 tbsp almond butter (95 cal)
- Pinch of cinnamon
- Black coffee or green tea

*Macros: 14g protein | 65g carbs | 10g fat*

---

## MID-MORNING SNACK (200 cal)
**Greek Yogurt & Berries**
- 200g plain Greek yogurt (130 cal)
- 1 cup mixed berries (70 cal)
- 1 tbsp honey (60 cal)

*Macros: 18g protein | 28g carbs | 1g fat*

---

## LUNCH (550 cal)
**Grilled Chicken & Brown Rice**
- 150g grilled chicken breast (280 cal)
- 1 cup cooked brown rice (215 cal)
- 1 cup steamed broccoli (35 cal)
- 1 tsp olive oil for cooking (20 cal)

*Macros: 42g protein | 60g carbs | 6g fat*

---

## PRE-WORKOUT SNACK (200 cal)
**Rice Cakes with Banana**
- 2 plain rice cakes (140 cal)
- 1 medium banana (105 cal)
- *Timing: 30-45 min before training*

*Macros: 3g protein | 48g carbs | 1g fat*

---

## DINNER (600 cal)
**Lean Beef Stir-Fry**
- 120g lean ground beef (240 cal)
- 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, snap peas) (60 cal)
- ½ cup white rice (100 cal)
- 1.5 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce (15 cal)
- 1 tbsp sesame oil (120 cal)
- Garlic & ginger

*Macros: 32g protein | 35g carbs | 15g fat*

---

## EVENING SNACK (optional, ~200 cal)
**Casein Protein Option**
- 1 scoop casein protein powder (110 cal)
- 250ml unsweetened almond milk (30 cal)
- 1 tbsp peanut butter (90 cal)
- *Or replace with: Apple + 20g almonds*

*Macros: 20g protein | 12g carbs | 9g fat*

---

## DAILY TOTALS
| Metric | Target | Achieved |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Calories** | 2000 | ~2000 |
| **Protein** | 140-150g | 145g |
| **Carbs** | 240g | 248g |
| **Fat** | 40-45g | 42g |

---

## HYDRATION & NOTES
✓ **Water**: 3-4 liters daily (more on training days)  
✓ **Electrolytes**: Consider coconut water or sports drink during intense sessions  
✓ **Timing**: Eat carbs 2-3 hours before boxing + 30-45 min before  
✓ **Post-workout**: Consume protein + carbs within 30-60 min  
✓ **Adjustments**: Add evening snack only if training intensity was high

---

**This plan supports weight maintenance while providing sustained energy, muscle recovery, and competition-ready performance.**

# One-Day Vegan Meal Plan for Strength & Power Development

**Athlete Profile:** 178 cm, 82 kg | Estimated daily caloric need: ~3,200-3,500 calories | Protein target: 130-140g

---

## **BREAKFAST** (7:00 AM)
*~750 calories | 28g protein*

- **Oatmeal Power Bowl**
  - 100g rolled oats
  - 400ml unsweetened soy milk
  - 2 tbsp almond butter
  - 1 banana, sliced
  - 1 tbsp ground flaxseed
  - Pinch of cinnamon

- **Side:** 1 slice whole grain toast with ½ avocado

---

## **MID-MORNING SNACK** (10:00 AM)
*~350 calories | 18g protein*

- **Protein Smoothie**
  - 1 scoop vegan protein powder (pea/hemp blend)
  - 250ml coconut milk
  - 1 cup frozen berries
  - 1 tbsp tahini
  - Handful of spinach

---

## **LUNCH** (1:00 PM)
*~850 calories | 32g protein*

- **Quinoa & Lentil Buddha Bowl**
  - 150g cooked quinoa
  - 150g cooked brown lentils
  - 100g roasted chickpeas
  - Mixed greens, tomatoes, cucumber
  - ¼ cup shredded purple cabbage
  - 3 tbsp tahini-lemon dressing
  - Sprinkle of pumpkin seeds

---

## **PRE-WORKOUT SNACK** (3:30 PM)
*~300 calories | 12g protein*

- 2 energy balls (dates, almonds, cacao)
- 1 medium apple
- 30g mixed nuts

---

## **POST-WORKOUT MEAL** (5:30 PM)
*~700 calories | 35g protein*

- **Tofu & Sweet Potato Power Plate**
  - 200g baked extra-firm tofu (marinated in tamari & ginger)
  - 200g roasted sweet potato
  - 100g steamed broccoli
  - 2 tbsp coconut oil for cooking
  - Nutritional yeast (2 tbsp)
  - Brown rice (1 cup cooked)

---

## **DINNER** (7:30 PM)
*~650 calories | 28g protein*

- **Black Bean & Walnut Tacos**
  - 2 whole wheat tortillas
  - 150g seasoned black beans
  - 75g walnuts (ground)
  - Shredded lettuce, salsa, cilantro
  - ¼ avocado
  - Side of Spanish rice with turmeric

---

## **EVENING SNACK** (9:00 PM)
*~250 calories | 10g protein*

- Vegan Greek yogurt (150g) with granola and berries
- Herbal tea

---

## **DAILY TOTALS**
- **Calories:** ~3,450
- **Protein:** 163g (19% of calories)
- **Carbs:** ~420g (49% of calories)
- **Fats:** ~100g (26% of calories)

---

## **KEY NUTRITIONAL STRATEGIES**

✅ **Complete Proteins:** Combines quinoa, legumes, tofu, nuts, and seeds for all 9 amino acids  
✅ **Carb-Loading:** High carbs support heavy training and glycogen replenishment  
✅ **Timing:** Post-workout meal within 1-2 hours of training  
✅ **Micronutrients:** B12 supplementation recommended (not naturally vegan)  
✅ **Iron Absorption:** Vitamin C sources (citrus, tomatoes) paired with iron-rich foods  
✅ **Omega-3s:** Flaxseed, chia, walnuts, and algae supplements recommended

---

# One-Day Marathon Training Meal Plan
**178 cm | 68 kg | Vegetarian | No Nuts**

---

## NUTRITIONAL TARGETS
- **Calories:** ~3,200-3,400 kcal (training day surplus)
- **Carbs:** 55-60% (~480-510g) — emphasized for endurance
- **Protein:** 1.6g/kg (~110g)
- **Fat:** 25-30% (~80-95g)

---

## MEAL BREAKDOWN

### **BREAKFAST (6:00-7:00 AM)** | 650 kcal
*Pre-morning run fuel*
- 2 cups oatmeal with water
- 1 banana, sliced
- 2 tbsp honey
- 1 cup low-fat Greek yogurt
- Pinch of sea salt

**Macros:** 95g carbs | 18g protein | 8g fat

---

### **PRE-WORKOUT SNACK (30 min before run)** | 200 kcal
*2-3 hours after breakfast*
- 1 large banana
- 200ml sports drink (6% carbs) or coconut water
- Rice cake with 1 tbsp jam

**Macros:** 48g carbs | 2g protein | 0g fat

---

### **LUNCH (12:00-1:00 PM)** | 750 kcal
*Post-run recovery meal (within 30-60 min of finishing)*
- 1.5 cups brown rice
- 200g grilled tofu or chickpea patty
- Roasted vegetables: bell pepper, zucchini, tomato (2 cups)
- 1 tbsp olive oil for cooking
- Small green salad with lemon dressing

**Macros:** 110g carbs | 25g protein | 15g fat

---

### **AFTERNOON SNACK (3:30-4:00 PM)** | 350 kcal
*Energy maintenance between training sessions*
- 1 large smoothie bowl:
  - 1.5 cups plant-based milk
  - 1 cup frozen berries
  - 40g plant-based protein powder
  - 2 tbsp seeds (sunflower or pumpkin)
  - ½ cup granola (nut-free)
  - 1 tbsp coconut oil

**Macros:** 65g carbs | 25g protein | 12g fat

---

### **DINNER (7:00-8:00 PM)** | 750 kcal
*Evening recovery*
- 1.5 cups whole wheat pasta
- Lentil bolognese sauce:
  - 180g cooked red lentils
  - 1 can crushed tomatoes
  - Garlic, onion, herbs
  - 1 tbsp olive oil
- Whole grain bread (1 slice)
- Roasted broccoli (1.5 cups)

**Macros:** 125g carbs | 28g protein | 18g fat

---

### **EVENING SNACK (Before Bed, optional)** | 200 kcal
*Sleep recovery support*
- 1 cup Greek yogurt
- ½ cup blueberries
- 1 tbsp honey
- 1 tbsp seeds

**Macros:** 35g carbs | 15g protein | 2g fat

---

## HYDRATION STRATEGY
- **Morning:** 500ml water upon waking
- **During run:** 500-750ml sports drink or water (depending on duration)
- **Throughout day:** Minimum 3-4L water total
- **Evening:** 300ml before bed

---

## KEY TIMING NOTES
✓ **Carbs within 30-60 min post-run** — maximizes glycogen replenishment  
✓ **Light pre-workout snack** — 30-60 min before running (easily digestible)  
✓ **Protein distributed** — 20-30g per meal for muscle repair  
✓ **No nuts** — seeds, legumes, and plant proteins substit
